name: pogo-dex
description: Self-Hosted Pokémon GO Dex Tracker for GitHub Pages and Ubuntu Server 26 / Docker

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const s=path.join('client','dist'),d=path.join('server','public');if(fs.existsSync(s)){fs.cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true});}"
scripts.build: npm run compile:data && npm run build:client
